steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: At the start of battle, Queen Hippolyta gains 20 Energy. She also restores 0.4% of her Max HP per second until the end of battle. After casting her Ultimate, she restores an additional 3% of her Max HP per second for 8s.

steps.label: 5★ White
steps.text: At the start of battle, Queen Hippolyta gains 30 Energy. She also restores 0.8% of her Max HP per second until the end of battle. After casting her Ultimate, she restores an additional 4.5% of her Max HP per second for 8s.

steps.label: 5★ Purple
steps.text: At the start of battle, Queen Hippolyta gains 40 Energy. She also restores 1.4% of her Max HP per second until the end of battle. After casting her Ultimate, she restores an additional 6% of her Max HP per second for 8s.

steps.label: 5★ Red
steps.text: At the start of battle, Queen Hippolyta gains 50 Energy. She also restores 2% of her Max HP per second until the end of battle. After casting her Ultimate, she restores an additional 7.5% of her Max HP per second for 8s.

steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Physical DEF by 20%. After the wearer casts their Ultimate, all other allies gain 5 Energy.

steps.label: 5★ Blue
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Physical DEF by 40%. After the wearer casts their Ultimate, all other allies gain 10 Energy.

steps.label: 5★ Yellow
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Physical DEF by 70%. After the wearer casts their Ultimate, all other allies gain 15 Energy.

guide.text: Queen Hippolyta's signature gear. Its universal skill increases Physical Defense and periodically grants Energy to allies. Its exclusive skill grants initial Energy and restores HP over time, enabling her to cast her Ultimate at the start of battle to withstand early enemy burst damage.
